_comment: Field items carried in the party satchel and used from the quick menu (issues #6, #112). Code: scripts/satchel.gd (using them), scripts/status.gd (what cures and buffs do), scripts/armory.gd (stores, packing, buying). target: 'hurt' = a standing hero below full HP, 'downed' = a downed hero, 'ink' = a standing hero short of Ink, 'cure' = a standing hero with one of the 'cures' statuses, 'hero' = any standing hero, 'party' = everyone standing (no target to pick), 'throw' = thrown at the enemy nearest the hero you control (within 'range' px). heal: HP restored ('revive' items bring a downed hero back at revive_pct of max HP). power: fills the attack gauge. ink: Ink restored. cures: statuses removed (poison, burn, stun, erase; 'all' = every one). buff: a timed boon from scripts/status.gd ({id, time}: might = damage x1.25, guard = 25% less damage taken, haste = faster feet and gauge, ward = proof against the Blank). immune: seconds the cured statuses can't come back. throw: {radius px, damage, status, time} on landing ('self': true bursts round the thrower instead). carry: most of this item the satchel holds at once (the satchel also has a total size, see data/market.json satchel). start: rations Hollowmark's stores put back in the satchel for free after every mission, up to what you packed. drop: chance a defeated enemy leaves one behind. price: Gilt at Tobble's Stall (stall: true) or the Market (prices there move with the Market's staff). icon: assets/icons/<id>.png. Order here is the quick menu's order.

tonic.name: Bitter Tonic
tonic.desc: Restores 25 HP to one hero. Tastes like a bad decision.

marrow_broth.name: Marrow Broth
marrow_broth.desc: Restores 70 HP and settles a poisoned gut. Gristle's recipe. Do not ask whose marrow.

salts.name: Smelling Salts
salts.desc: Gets a downed hero back up at half HP, enemies or not.

draught.name: Black Draught
draught.desc: Whole party: attack gauges full and 8 HP each. Mostly coffee.

wormwood.name: Wormwood Drops
wormwood.desc: Burns out poison, cools a burn, and keeps both off for 10 seconds. Bitter enough to make the tonic taste kind.

fresh_ink.name: Pot of Fresh Ink
fresh_ink.desc: Restores 30 Ink and writes an Erased hero back in. Still wet. Don't drink it, whatever Bran says.

clean_sheet.name: Clean Sheet
clean_sheet.desc: Whole party: every ailment wiped, and nothing sticks for 6 seconds. A page with nothing wrong written on it yet.

iron_tea.name: Iron Tea
iron_tea.desc: Whole party: 25% less damage taken for 30 seconds. Brewed with a horseshoe in the pot.

gutter_gin.name: Gutter Gin
gutter_gin.desc: One hero hits 25% harder for 30 seconds. Distilled in a gutter. The gutter has a name, and a following.

courier_snuff.name: Courier's Snuff
courier_snuff.desc: Whole party: faster feet and a faster gauge for 25 seconds. One sniff and you can hear colours.

oil_flask.name: Lamp-oil Flask
oil_flask.desc: Thrown at the nearest enemy: everything near it catches fire. Lampwick's finest, and its most common complaint.

flash_powder.name: Flash Powder
flash_powder.desc: A white flash round the hero you control: every enemy close by is stunned for a moment. Bosses only blink.

ward_candle.name: Ward Candle
ward_candle.desc: Whole party, 45 seconds: the Blank can't Erase you, its edge doesn't burn, its creatures lose interest, and every hit lands a quarter softer.
